353:t_2:13.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「What does that mean, $$フェルト$$?」

353:t_2:14.en:
$$フェルト$$
「I went over the $$蒼の地球$$ battle data $$万丈$$ gave us, and Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ has won on every battlefield she's sortied to.」

353:t_2:15.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「You're saying she's really that great a commander...?」

353:t_2:16.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「And yet someone like that pulled back so easily today.」

353:t_2:17.en:
$$フェルト$$
「There may have been some intent behind it.」

353:t_2:18.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「What do you think, $$スメラギ$$?」

353:t_2:21.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Sorry. I was just thinking about the EVAs...」

353:t_2:22.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「It's a reunion with people we never thought we'd see again, after all. I can see how it'd hit you.」

353:t_2:23.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(I heard that when the world of the red sea shifted here, it was on the verge of being destroyed by $$サードインパクト$$...)

353:t_2:24.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(And EVA Unit-01, with $$シンジ$$ aboard, was at the center of it...)

353:t_2:25.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(I can't believe it's a coincidence that an EVA has come to this world again now...)

353:t_2:26.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(EVA... Its existence may even hold the power to sway the fate of the world... And yet nobody knows what it really is...)

353:t_2:30.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ Briefing Room ～

353:t_2:31.en:
$$カヲル$$
「...With the data the people on this ship gave us, we've come to understand the situation on this Earth.」

353:t_2:34.en:
$$カヲル$$
「When we pulled the spear out during that battle in $$セントラルドグマ$$, a $$時空震動$$ occurred...」

353:t_2:35.en:
$$シンジ$$
「How... could something like that happen...」

353:t_2:36.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I don't fully understand it either. But I can sort of guess.」

353:t_2:37.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It must be the result of the world rejecting us.」

353:t_2:39.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It's an act that breaks the order of things, after all. Naturally, a risk like that comes with it.」

353:t_2:40.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You've been acting all high and mighty this whole time... Who are you?」

353:t_2:41.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'm $$渚カヲル$$... $$シンジ$$'s friend, and the pilot of Unit-13.」

353:t_2:42.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Nice to meet you, $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$ and $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$.」

353:t_2:43.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, that's a surprise. You even know our names.」

353:t_2:44.en:
$$アスカ$$
「So you saw them in the $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ files, huh.」

353:t_2:45.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

353:t_2:46.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You're way too familiar, you know that? Just taking charge of this place on your own.」

353:t_2:47.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Stop it, $$アスカ$$... $$カヲル$$ is...」

353:t_2:48.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Do you get it, Brat $$シンジ$$?! Our $$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$ exists to take down your $$ＮＥＲＶ$$!」

353:t_2:49.en:
$$アスカ$$
「And it's all because 14 years ago, you almost set off $$サードインパクト$$!」

353:t_2:50.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...I... just wanted to save $$綾波$$...」

353:t_2:51.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Do you even know what became of most of the world as a result...!?」

353:t_2:53.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Sure... maybe you didn't do it because you wanted to, but where are the people left behind supposed to take out their feelings!」

353:t_2:54.en:
$$マリ$$
「...I think it's misdirected to take it out on Puppy, too, nya~」

353:t_2:56.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I did all that... and in the end, I couldn't... save $$綾波$$...)

353:t_2:58.en:
$$シンジ$$
(That girl looks just like $$綾波$$, but she isn't $$綾波$$... But I...)

353:t_2:59.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Lift your head, $$シンジ$$. You'd stopped looking down, hadn't you?」

353:t_2:61.en:
$$カヲル$$
「We decided to repair the world, didn't we?」

353:t_2:62.en:
$$アスカ$$
「And you're saying it's fine if humanity is wiped out for that?」

353:t_2:63.en:
$$カヲル$$
「I suppose it looks that way from your side.」

353:t_2:64.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Putting on that face like you're the only one who understands...!」

353:t_2:65.en:
$$マリ$$
「Okay, okay! Hold it right there, $$姫$$!」

353:t_2:66.en:
$$マリ$$
「We got thrown off right after pulling one of the spears out of $$リリス$$, but we should have at least stopped the world from collapsing...」

353:t_2:67.en:
$$マリ$$
「What's left is what we do from here. Including whether or not we can get back.」

353:t_2:72.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Luckily, we've been able to make contact with people $$シンジ$$ and you are familiar with.」

353:t_2:73.en:
$$カヲル$$
「And the organization that holds great power in this world seems to view EVA as an enemy.」

353:t_2:74.en:
$$マリ$$
「W-well... attempt or not, anyone who saw $$サードインパクト$$ would think so. Can't blame them.」

353:t_2:75.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Returning to our world is the top priority, but until things settle down, I think it's best to act together with this $c.」

353:t_2:76.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Of course, in the meantime... we're under a temporary truce.」

353:t_2:78.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What do you want to do, $$シンジ$$?」

353:t_2:80.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's fine if you decide, $$カヲル$$.」

353:t_2:81.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Reluctant as it is, I'll take that as agreement with my proposal.」

353:t_2:82.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Brat $$シンジ$$... You can't even decide how to live your own life by yourself, can you.」

353:t_2:83.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...What am I supposed to be able to do in a situation like this...」

353:t_2:84.en:
$$シンジ$$
「And even if I decide on my own, if I'm told the world was destroyed because of it...」

353:t_2:86.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What will you two do? Leave and live on your own?」

353:t_2:87.en:
$$マリ$$
「No way...! I know how cozy this unit is, after all.」

353:t_2:88.en:
$$マリ$$
「Come on, $$姫$$... Quit being stubborn, and let's shake on the truce or something.」

353:t_2:90.en:
$$マリ$$
「...$$姫$$ is in a sour mood, but there's no other choice anyway...」

353:t_2:92.en:
$$マリ$$
「I'll take you up on your proposal. You, me, her, him and that girl, the five of us will go live in this world overflowing with battle.」

353:t_2:93.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Understood. Then let's convey our intentions to this unit's commander.」

353:t_2:94.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well then, $$姫$$... Forget the guy over there, how about a handshake with Puppy for now?」

uncertain: 353:t_2:34 / :66: the spear-pulling has no subject; rendered 'we' (Kaworu, Shinji, Mari all took part in the Central Dogma fight). :34 says 'the spear', :66 'one of the spears'.
353:t_2:55: コネメガネ (Asuka to Mari; 'connection glasses') rendered 'Four-Eyes' - the connection pun is lost; no settled rendering exists.
353:t_2:48: ヴィレ rendered with the existing token $$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$ (ヴィレ has no token of its own).
353:t_2:72: 'シンジ君や君達の馴染みのある人達' read as 'people Shinji and you are familiar with' (alternative: Shinji himself plus your acquaintances).
353:t_2:94: あっちの彼 read as Kaworu (Shinji is ワンコ君, named separately). In :92 the five are Kaworu, Mari, Asuka (彼女), Shinji (彼), Rei (あの子).
353:t_2:14/:15: ストラウス is [female] in the glossary, so 'she'; ラッセ's 名将 line is therefore 'she'.
353:t_2:88: Mari calls Asuka 姫 = 'Princess' (settled); ガキシンジ = 'Brat $$シンジ$$'.
